text:
The Edmund S. Muskie Internship Program is a professional exchange program supported by the United States Department of State. It provides Eurasian scholars and graduate students with financial support, career training, and summer internship placements while studying in the United States.
The program was established by the United States Congress in the 1992 fiscal year through the Freedom Support Act of 1992. Its scope and format were renewed and launched by Cultural Vistas in 2015, having previously been administered by the International Research & Exchanges Board and the American Council of Teachers of Russian/American Council for Collaboration in Education and Language.
